cards.title: One clean database
cards.scenario: A citizen record existed only in the primary database. The delete completed, a direct lookup is empty, and no copy, model, cache, export, or recovery path is registered.

explanation_choices.label: All registered places and return paths are clear.
A known copy can still return the record.
Mandatory evidence is missing.

cards.title: Search index copy
cards.scenario: The database row is gone, but a materialized search index still contains the same subject and can answer queries.

explanation_choices.label: All registered places and return paths are clear.
A known copy can still return the record.
Mandatory evidence is missing.
